summary: Getting too close to an end gateway causes the game to crash
description: The bug Going too close to the end gateway will cause the game to crash! Stack trace 1.15 Pre-release 1 : [^crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16 at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBounds(Preconditions.java:64) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBoundsCheckIndex(Preconditions.java:70) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.checkIndex(Preconditions.java:248) at java.base/java.util.Objects.checkIndex(Objects.java:372) at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:458) at dsy.a(SourceFile:41) at dsx.a(SourceFile:30) at dsx.a(SourceFile:11) at dsk.a(SourceFile:106) at dsk.b(SourceFile:95) at dsk.a(SourceFile:127) at dsk.a(SourceFile:95) at dqm.a(SourceFile:1180) at dqi.a(SourceFile:719) at dqi.a(SourceFile:549) at dbj.d(SourceFile:941) at dbj.b(SourceFile:576) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:202)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.15 Pre-release 1.
2. Create or load an End dimension world containing end gateways.
3. Navigate to an end gateway structure in the world.
4. Move your character close to the end gateway block entity.
5. Observe that the game crashes when getting too close to the end gateway.
Observed Behavior: When players get too close to an end gateway, the game crashes immediately. This issue was observed in Minecraft Java Edition 1.15 Pre-release 1 and is associated with a specific stack trace that indicates an `IndexOutOfBoundsException` during block entity rendering. The error message reads: "Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16," pointing to the source file lines where the exception occurs. This bug specifically affects the interaction between players and end gateways, causing instability and a complete crash when proximity is reached. The crash log can be found in `crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt`, providing developers with detailed information to diagnose and address this issue.
Expected Behavior: When getting too close to an end gateway, the game should not crash. Instead, players should be able to approach and interact with the end gateway normally without any issues or unexpected behavior. The game should remain stable and continue running smoothly.
